add.installDirTooltip: On nodes without docker the runveil runtime keeps images and container root filesystems here too, so choose a local filesystem; a network volume that refuses ':' in file names (such as RunPod's /workspace) does not work.
add.useSystemdTooltip: On: the agent is registered as the gpuworks-agent systemd service, started at boot and restarted when it crashes. Off: the agent runs in the background under nohup, with agent-restart.sh in the install directory for restarting it by hand; the host's existing gpuworks-agent service and agents in other directories are left alone, so another install directory adds one more agent to the same host. Hosts without systemd, or without root or passwordless sudo, always use nohup; macOS nodes use launchd regardless.
add.useSystemdOffHelp: The agent does not start at boot and is not restarted when it exits
add.agentListenAddressHelp: Where the agent listens on this host (or in its container): its --listen.
add.offlineInstructions: The node cannot reach the management node, so it installs from the offline package: download it, copy it to the node (scp, a web terminal or JupyterLab upload), and run the command below in the directory that holds it. The package holds no token and is the same for every node.

gpuIsolation.summary: Instances on this node can see every GPU device of the node; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES keeps each one to the card it was given. Software that ignores CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, or opens /dev/nvidiaN directly, can reach the other cards.

reason.cdi_names_missing: NVIDIA's container toolkit runs in CDI mode and no CDI spec on the node names {{cards}} of its NVIDIA cards, typically because HAMi or another device plugin replaced NVIDIA's, which is what writes the per-card names. Instances therefore get every card, and are held to theirs by CUDA only.

fix.gpu_operator_device_plugin: The cluster uses the GPU Operator and no other GPU device plugin: keep the Operator's own device plugin enabled, which writes the per-card CDI names. Do not run it next to HAMi or another device plugin; both would advertise the same GPUs.
fix.gpu_operator_toolkit_legacy_append: Switch the Operator's toolkit to legacy mode, which isolates by card index. Use this when spec.toolkit.env already exists: it appends to the list and keeps its entries.
fix.gpu_operator_toolkit_legacy_create: Use this one instead when the command above fails because spec.toolkit.env does not exist yet: it creates the list (and would replace one that exists).
fix.host_toolkit_legacy: The toolkit is installed on the node without the GPU Operator: switch it to legacy mode on the node (nvidia-ctk edits /etc/nvidia-container-runtime/config.toml), then restart the container runtime (containerd; use rke2-agent, k3s or your distribution's service name if it differs).

gpuProbeFailed.detail:
Since {{at}} the vendor tool has not answered, so for this node's own cards anything only that tool knows — memory, UUID, health — is still what it last reported: {{detail}}

Which cards are in the machine, whose they are and where they sit comes from the PCI bus and is unaffected.

scheduling.title: Scheduling on {{node}}

blocked.title: This node's runtime cannot use its accelerators
blocked.description:
{{reason}}

Every deployment placed here would fail when its container starts. The platform cordoned the node for this reason and will do so again on its next report unless the cause is fixed.

reason.gpu_plugin_missing: The container runtime {{runtime}} needs the vendor GPU plugin {{plugin}}, which is not installed, so a container cannot be given this node's accelerators.
reason.gpu_runtime_unconfigured: {{runtime}} is running with no GPU support configured, so a container cannot be given this node's accelerators. Installing the vendor plugin is not enough; {{runtime}} has to be told to use it (NVIDIA: nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker, then restart Docker).

help.schedulable: The node takes new replicas. Cordon it to keep new ones off while what runs keeps running, or drain it to also move the replicas placed from a pool onto other nodes.
help.cordoned: No new replica is started here; what runs keeps running. Drain to move the pool-placed replicas off, or make it schedulable again.
help.draining: No new replica is started here. Replacements start on other nodes before existing replicas retire, so service capacity is retained. Pinned replicas wait for a placement change; multi-node and PD units wait until suitable replacement nodes are available.

action.evictConfirm: Take every replica off this node now, without waiting for replacements? Pinned replicas and multi-node or PD ranks wait until the node is schedulable again or their deployment names another node.

done.schedulable: The node takes new replicas again

scheduling.stuck: {{count}} replica(s) are pinned to this node. Change their deployment’s node requirements, or explicitly evict them.

kind.named: Moves its unit after a replacement is ready

scheduling.drainHint: Open Scheduling and drain to see waiting replicas, scheduling feedback, or stop the drain while keeping the node cordoned.
scheduling.waiting: Waiting for {{count}} replica(s) to leave: replacements must be ready before existing service is retired.
scheduling.stopHint: Check each deployment’s latest feedback. You can stop further drain work while keeping the node cordoned; work already in progress may finish. The platform does not automatically enable scheduling or force replicas off the node.
scheduling.completed: No active replicas remain. The node still takes no new replicas; stop the drain to leave it cordoned.
scheduling.retiring: Retiring this instance; waiting for in-flight requests and removal confirmation.
scheduling.pinnedReason: The deployment is pinned to this node. Change its node requirements, or explicitly evict it.
scheduling.lastFailedAttempt: Latest failed attempt on another node: {{message}}
scheduling.awaitingReason: Waiting for a replacement. No scheduling refusal has been reported yet; check the deployment’s instances and model/image preparation.
scheduling.offline: The node is offline: retirement and container removal cannot be confirmed.
scheduling.offlineHint: Restore its agent connection and check its instances. You can stop the drain while keeping the node cordoned; the platform will not enable scheduling or claim that removal succeeded.

by.operator: Stopped by an administrator; the platform never lifts it.
by.platformLifts: The platform turns scheduling back on once the reason is gone.

cordonReason.card_needs_host_reboot: Stopped by the platform: a card reports that only a host reboot or power cycle recovers it, and the other cards sit behind the same driver.
cordonReason.kube_unschedulable: Stopped by the platform: Kubernetes stopped scheduling onto this node (kubectl cordon or drain, or the node is being replaced).

disk_low.label: Low disk space
disk_low.impact: Image pulls and model downloads may fail.

runtime_unavailable.label: Container runtime not responding
runtime_unavailable.summary: The selected container runtime query failed.
runtime_unavailable.impact: This node cannot start inference instances.

runtime_provision_failed.label: Runtime setup failed
runtime_provision_failed.summary: The container runtime could not be set up on this node. Its last attempt failed with the error below.
runtime_provision_failed.impact: Every deployment on this node fails until the cause is fixed. The agent tries again by itself, waiting 30 seconds after the first failure and up to 5 minutes later on.

runtime_state_untraversable.label: Runtime user cannot reach the agent directory
runtime_state_untraversable.summary: {{directory}} is not searchable by {{user}}, the user workloads run as, so it cannot reach the agent directory {{stateDir}}.
runtime_state_untraversable.impact: Every workload launch on this node fails with permission denied on the runtime's own files. Open the directory with `{{fix}}`, which grants search only, no listing or writing, or reinstall the agent with an install directory outside it.

path_noexec.label: Path mounted noexec
path_noexec.summary: {{path}} is on {{point}} ({{fstype}}), which is mounted noexec.
path_noexec.impact: Programs the runtime runs from this path cannot start. Install the agent into a directory on a filesystem that allows execution, or remount without noexec.

path_read_only.label: Path mounted read-only
path_read_only.summary: {{path}} is on {{point}} ({{fstype}}), which is mounted read-only.
path_read_only.impact: The agent cannot write models, images or runtime state there. Use a writable directory or remount read-write.

path_ephemeral.label: Data on the container layer
path_ephemeral.summary: {{path}} is on this container's own filesystem layer ({{fstype}} at {{point}}), not on a volume.
path_ephemeral.impact: Models, images and runtime state are lost when the container is recreated. Install the agent into a persistent volume on a local filesystem if the instance has one; a network volume that refuses ':' in file names, such as RunPod's /workspace, cannot hold the runveil runtime's images.

accelerator_probe_failed.label: Accelerator probe failed
accelerator_probe_failed.impact: The accelerators on this node cannot be scheduled.

accelerator_unrecognized.label: Unrecognized accelerator devices
accelerator_unrecognized.summary: This host has PCI devices belonging to a supported vendor that match none of that vendor's rules, usually a model we have not seen.
accelerator_unrecognized.impact: They are left out of the accelerator list and are unavailable for allocation. Send the PCI ids below so the rule can be added.

cuda_init_failed.label: CUDA initialization failed
cuda_init_failed.summary: The CUDA driver failed to initialize. The recheck command prints 0 when initialization succeeds.
cuda_init_failed.impact: This node cannot run CUDA inference.

multi_gpu_check_failed.label: Multi-GPU check failed
multi_gpu_check_failed.summary: A multi-GPU communication check did not pass.
multi_gpu_check_failed.impact: Multi-GPU tensor parallelism may fail to start.

macos_unsupported.label: macOS too old
macos_unsupported.summary: Mac nodes need macOS {{required}} or later; the evidence shows this Mac's version.
macos_unsupported.impact: Environment packages cannot run here, so no instance can be deployed on this node. Upgrade macOS and run the diagnosis again.

macos_idle_sleep.label: Sleeps when idle
macos_idle_sleep.summary: With the settings for its current power source, this Mac goes to sleep after being idle. The agent prevents idle sleep while an instance runs, not otherwise.
macos_idle_sleep.impact: A sleeping Mac is offline: new deployments cannot be scheduled here until it wakes. To keep it available, turn off idle sleep on AC power: sudo pmset -c sleep 0 (the platform does not change this setting).

peer_memory_missing.label: GPUDirect RDMA unavailable
peer_memory_missing.summary: This host has RDMA NICs, but the peer-memory module {{module}} is not loaded, so the NICs cannot register the cards' memory.
peer_memory_missing.impact: Instances still run, but PD modes that move KV over RDMA cannot be placed on this node. Run the fix command in the evidence on the node (it also loads the module at boot), then diagnose again.

connectionDiagnostics.title: Connection evidence
connectionDiagnostics.scope: Reads the running Agent’s connection snapshot over its existing control channel. Offline or older agents may use the optional saved SSH access. It does not change addresses, credentials, installation or recovery state.
connectionDiagnostics.empty: Run a check to collect evidence, including when the Agent control connection is offline.
connectionDiagnostics.failed: The report could not be collected. Retry or inspect the control-plane log.
connectionDiagnostics.lastObserved: Last observed at {{time}}; this is not a live availability check.

outcome.unavailable: Connection evidence is unavailable; other recorded observations remain available.
outcome.not_applicable: Not applicable for this connection direction
outcome.invalid_address: Address is invalid or contains unsupported credentials, query parameters or fragments.
outcome.unverified_identity: Could not verify that this installation belongs to the selected node.
outcome.timeout: No answer within the check’s time limit.
outcome.command_failed: The read-only SSH command did not complete.
outcome.invalid_response: The node returned an unsupported or oversized diagnostic response.
outcome.snapshot: Configuration snapshot read; running flags or environment overrides have not been verified.
outcome.tool_missing: curl is unavailable on the node; the HTTP check was not run.
outcome.http_error: The endpoint answered with an unexpected HTTP status.
outcome.http_ok: The health URL returned HTTP 200. WebSocket and Agent authentication were not tested.
outcome.dns: The node could not resolve the target or its configured proxy.
outcome.connect: The node could not establish a connection.
outcome.tls: The node could not complete TLS or verify its certificate.
outcome.transport: The HTTP exchange failed before a complete response.
outcome.unsupported: This installation does not support connection diagnostics.
outcome.credentials_unavailable: SSH access is not configured; the optional SSH checks were not run.
outcome.credential_error: Saved SSH credentials could not be read; node-side checks were not run.
outcome.runtime_snapshot: The control RPC returned a current-process snapshot; no new connection was opened.
outcome.offline: No live Agent control session; current node-side evidence could not be requested.

guidance.snapshot_scope: A configuration snapshot does not prove the running process has adopted it. Check the selected state directory, startup flags and environment overrides; never share TOKEN or full process arguments.
guidance.http_scope: An HTTP health response does not prove WebSocket, Agent authentication, inference streaming or a user’s network path is working. SSH curl uses the SSH session environment, which may differ from the running Agent’s proxy and NO_PROXY settings.
guidance.test_from_node: On the affected node, run gpuworks-agent smoke --state <actual-state-directory> and inspect agent.log from the same directory.
guidance.manual_address_update: This check does not repair addresses. A change requires an administrator to verify both the platform record and the Agent configuration. In-place address migration is not provided by this diagnostic. Use a stable address for long-term connections.
guidance.addresses_differ: The saved address differs from the connector’s last observed public entry. Verify the intended entry; this difference alone does not prove the old address is invalid.
guidance.configuration_differs: The node configuration snapshot differs from the platform’s saved address. Check startup overrides and the intended control plane before changing either value.
guidance.server_dial_scope: For server-initiated connections, inspect the Agent listen address and the control plane → node path. The node does not need to call a control-plane health URL.

connectionDiagnostics.cliScope: An offline Agent cannot receive a new RPC. Run the command through the node’s console using the actual state directory. CLI configuration and proxy settings may differ from the running service. Cancelling this page stops waiting; the Agent limits its own work.

runtime.scope: This is a snapshot of the existing connection, not a new control/data handshake or an inference test. Missing stages remain unverified. A pending or unverified data channel is not a successful data check.

control.smoke_verified: One smoke handshake verified; daemon health is unverified

data_lane.attached: Data channel currently attached; throughput is untested
data_lane.detached: Previously attached data channel is disconnected; data operations wait for reconnection
data_lane.disabled: Dedicated data channel disabled; single-channel mode
data_lane.pending: Dedicated data channel has not attached yet
data_lane.not_applicable: Not applicable for this connection direction

outcome.ok: The listed observations completed; full-path health is not established
outcome.not_applicable: Not applicable for this connection direction

reason.stale_session: Data connection belongs to a stale control session

proxy.environment_proxy: Environment proxy used by the transport

summary.failed: Diagnosis completed with failed checks. Review the evidence and suggested actions.
summary.warning: Diagnosis completed with checks that need attention.
summary.unavailable: Diagnosis completed with unavailable checks. Review their reasons.
summary.completed: Diagnosis completed. Review the checks and detailed information.

reason.credentials_unavailable: No SSH credentials are available for node inspection. Independent Server-side checks still run.
reason.credential_error: Saved SSH credentials could not be read. Check the node SSH configuration.
reason.ssh_unavailable: SSH is unavailable. Check its address, credentials and network.
reason.ssh_connected: SSH connected during this inspection. This verifies only the inspection channel.
reason.inspection_unavailable: Node information could not be read. Check SSH account permissions and required tools.
reason.not_installed: No Agent binary exists in the target installation directory. Check the directory and installation result.
reason.installed: An Agent binary exists in the target installation directory.
reason.not_running: This check found no running Agent service or process for the target installation. Check its service state.
reason.running: This check found the Agent service or process for the target installation directory running.
reason.not_observed: No reliable evidence is available for this connection stage.
reason.administrator_required: Node access inspection requires an administrator. Run diagnosis with an administrator account.
reason.invalid_address: No valid connection target is configured. Check the node connection settings.
reason.tcp_connected: The target TCP port is reachable.
reason.dns: Target name resolution failed. Check DNS at the initiating endpoint.
reason.connect: Target connection failed. Check the address, port and network path.
reason.refused: The target TCP connection was refused. Check the listener, service and reject policies.
reason.tls: TLS establishment failed. Check certificates, system time and target protocol.
reason.timeout: The connection timed out. The blocking location is unknown; check routing and access policies between endpoints.
reason.cancelled: The check was cancelled before a complete result was available.
reason.transport: A transport error occurred. Check connection records at both endpoints.
reason.identity_unverified: The installation could not be associated with this node. The node-side network probe was not run; check node identity and installation directory.
reason.http_connected: The compute node can access the management node's health check endpoint.
reason.http_error: The Server health endpoint returned an unexpected HTTP status. Check the target, service and proxy configuration.
reason.tool_missing: curl is unavailable on the node; the HTTP probe could not run.
reason.authentication_not_checked: This check tests reachability without performing Agent authentication, so its authentication result is unavailable.
reason.requires_agent: This check requires a connected Agent.
reason.not_reported: The Agent did not return structured results for this item. Review the original report.
reason.information_collected: Detailed information is available. Findings are listed separately among the checks.
